summary: Returnables in the business assistant (in-app, WhatsApp and Telegram share the tools). New orders take returnables going out ("58 crates to be returned") through prepareOrder.request.returnables or order_create.returnables, bound to a Returnable catalog item by name and issued atomically with the order (returnablesSource assistant); a paid share ("70% paid") is payment.percent, converted after pricing. New draft action returnable_movement_record (RETURNED, WRITTEN_OFF or ISSUED, by customer name or order number) with a balance before → after review, and a read tool readReturnableBalances. product_create and Setup accept usage RETURNABLE (no price or stock). Walk-in orders, unknown items and returns above the customer's balance are refused before anything is saved. Prompt general-v39. Design: Workshop assistant/conversations v19 (rev 11e8ecad, selected by the owner 14 Nov 2026).

capabilities.note: readReturnableBalances: outstanding balances per customer and Returnable item (orders, oldest date out) and the items set up, through returnables.balances and returnables.items. Gated by assertCanOperateOrders like the router; scoped staff stay denied because staff-procedure-policy does not list returnables.* (same as the app).

returnable_movement_record drafts one ledger entry; prepare resolves customer, order (ORD-1035 from "#1035") and item; review shows the balance before → after and refuses more back than held; Confirm calls recordReturnableMovement with source assistant and an idempotent clientMovementId. Native WhatsApp review is staged (ASSISTANT_WHATSAPP_NATIVE_REVIEW_ACTIONS) and app review meanwhile; mobile edits quantity, Returned/Lost and note; receipt opens the customer.

procedures.reason: Order Returnables card in the app; the assistant review reads the same per-order allocation directly.
returnables.read lists the Returnable items so the model can name them; order preparation binds names to the same list.
Movement history screens on the customer and Returnables list; the assistant answers with balances.

evidence.result: 19 tests pass: name resolution (crates → Egg crate, cylinders, ambiguity, not set up), order returnables and issues (walk-in, unbound, duplicates), whole quantities, paid percent (70% of ₦480,000 = ₦336,000, rounds down), movement action schema and summary.
5 tests pass: counts, order card section (holds 12 → 70), balance filters and answers (total first, none, not set up).

Guarded Neon development QA (ewatrade_qa_v1, own tenant removed after): not-set-up order and refused movement, prepared order binds 58 crates, walk-in refused, direct order_create issues 58 with the order (12 → 70, source assistant), walk-in order cannot confirm, 78 back from "Chidi" (96 → 18), 30 back on "#n" (74 → 44), 200 over balance refused with Record 70, 5 written off (70 → 65). 1 test, 24 assertions pass.

Model smoke returnables-farm, returnables-gas, returnables-none pass on deepseek-flash with general-v39 (runs/2026-11-14-returnables-smoke.json): sale line kept separate from crates out, percent 70 with no worked-out amount, 3 gas cylinders out, no returnables when crates are only the unit.
RT-01–RT-12 defined: farm, gas, walk-in, not set up, by customer, by order, balances, write-off, over-return, sold-goods and no-returnables negatives, injection and authority.
